issue_request: FHIR-20204 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction reporting that the Java JAR validator incorrectly rejected PZN and similar codings when the CodeSystem intentionally has no explicit concept list.
initial_application: No HL7/fhir source commit explicitly references FHIR-20204 and no current source file contains FHIR-20204, ifa/pzn, or fhir.de/CodeSystem/ifa/pzn. Jira shows the issue was assigned for investigation and later published, with a final comment directing remaining validator problems to hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-01-27 classified the tracker as a technical correction and assigned investigation, without recording a core spec wording change. The original and later Zulip discussions frame the PZN behavior as Java/core-validator or terminology-server handling. GitHub evidence locates the relevant Java validator messages/source in hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. A single empty external-repo audit commit is present on the combined branch documenting that any remaining implementation fix belongs outside this HL7/fhir specification checkout.
